incbot: Pager triggered: collective-hang on cluster-prod-12 (tp4 jobs). NCCL detected long-running allreduce; 3 participants unresponsive. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nccl-hang charlie_oncall: saw the page, jumping in. which pods affected? maya_infra: jobs: rp-training-42 (tp4, 8 GPUs), rp-eval-7, customerA-infer-01. nodes: gpu-node-12a,b,c. nvlink errors in dmesg on node-12b. charlie_oncall: any immediate customer impact? product_ops? product_ops: customerA reports inference latency spike and 502s for ~2 minutes. mark P1 customer. getting logs now. leo_ml: quick triage: NCCL rank 2 (node-12b) stuck in AllReduce, peer heartbeat timed out. logs show repeated `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` then `Xid 79: GPU page fault` on that GPU. aj_dev: can we try graceful drain and restart of the pod on node-12b? prefer not to kill the whole job without trying restart. maya_infra: planning: (1) cordon node-12b, (2) kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data node-12b, (3) restart rp-training-42 pods on other nodes. charlie_oncall: do it. collect kernel + nvlink topology before drain: `kubectl exec -it

-- nvidia-smi topo -m` and `dmesg | tail -n 80` maya_infra: running commands now. attaching output snippet: ``` GPU0 Xid=79 at 0x7f... illegal address NVLink: peer 12c link cap err, retry count 4 nvidia-smi topo: NVLINK between GPU0<->GPU1: OK, GPU1<->GPU2: DEGRADED ``` leo_ml: NVLink retried links can cause short silent packet loss; with TP parallelism, that can stall rendezvous. try `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0`? but this is on inter-GPU fabric not socket. aj_dev: alternative: set `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1` and restart pod so NCCL aborts faster and job can fallback to 1-GPU replica. charlie_oncall: maya, proceed with drain+restart + set NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING for restarted pods. coordinate with product_ops for customer comms. maya_infra: cordoned node-12b. draining now. pods evicted; starting replacements with env override. watching. product_ops: told customerA: "We're investigating a GPU communication failure causing elevated errors/latency; mitigation in progress. Will update in 15m." :hourglass_flowing_sand: aj_dev: replacements came up on nodes 12a/c and node-14. rp-training-42 resumed; logs show NCCL abort on old rank and clean restart on new ranks. leo_ml: post-restart check: `nccl-tests` on new placement passes allreduce microbench. embedding inference for customerA returned to normal. charlie_oncall: good. mark incident as mitigated. can someone capture root cause hypothesis and required follow-ups? leo_ml: hypothesis: transient NVLink hardware error on node-12b caused packet corruption -> GPU Xid79 -> NCCL rank hung. Follow-ups: replace GPU on node-12b, run hardware nvlink stress tests, add NCCl debug env by default for tp workloads. maya_infra: filed infra ticket INFRA-2247 to schedule GPU RMA for node-12b and run stress suite. adding node-level nvlink telemetry to alert on DEGRADATION. product_ops: writing customer update: "Root cause under investigation; we've restored capacity and will follow up with full postmortem and timeline." ETA customer update in 2h. sre_lead: assign postmortem owner: leo_ml. add timeline, commit to quantifying how many jobs affected and cost impact. link: https://redwood.incidents/5787654321/postmortem charlie_oncall: thanks all. closing pager as mitigated. :white_check_mark: incbot: Pager status: RESOLVED by charlie_oncall at 5787654600
